tagline: VS Code’s editor, in a file. One invite is a pair session.
description:
The buffers live in this file — close it, come back, your TypeScript is still there, and it works on a plane. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend types in the same editor. No account, no server, no pastebin.

This is the real Monaco editor from VS Code, not a JSON form: IntelliSense for JavaScript and TypeScript, JSON validation as you type, Markdown, a file tree, Find, format, a minimap. On a phone the files sit behind one tap and the keyboard still leaves room to edit.

An unofficial port of the Monaco Editor by Microsoft. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
